findings.summary: Spec line 17 requires UTC start/end, exact argv, exit code and unabridged raw trailing output for *every* command, but the durable record for acceptance items 1-3 (implement handoff verification_record) carries only argv + exit_code, plus pass/fail counts for pytest -- no UTC start/end and no raw tail. Items 4 and 5 do meet the full evidence shape in tests/reports/e1_real_bus_refs_drill.md. Not blocking: the verification_record shape is fixed by the dispatch contract rather than chosen by the implementer, and the substantive requirement (all three commands green, 14/14 resolver tests) is machine-attested.

In the real-bus drills the *bus* is genuinely real (BusClient over HTTP to the running agent-bus; the bridge subprocess gets a real read credential and its GET /v1/entities/<id>/refs hits the real endpoint, with refs_to_question read back from it), while the resume owner remains an isolated FakeOwnerState. This matches spec item 4, whose 'not a mocked adapter' bound is on the refs endpoint, and the script documents the boundary at scripts/e1_decision_bridge_acceptance.py:536-539. Recorded so the scope of the live drill is explicit, not as a defect.

Product-tree equality between fd066c452bf634036eb112d277d6533f29ce0989 and 149e928d394840a14f3a44a577b03d1d60674886 outside .dev-dispatch could not be checked mechanically: this reviewer has file-inspection tools only (Read/Grep/Glob) and executed no shell or git command. The required `git diff --exit-code ... ':(exclude).dev-dispatch'` was therefore not run; the review was conducted against the worktree contents at /data/worktrees/fleet-graph-f6-real-bus-refs-h0-20260829. For the same reason, tracked-vs-untracked status of tests/reports/e1_real_bus_refs_drill.md was inferred from .gitignore (which does not exclude tests/reports/) rather than from the index.

Record discrepancy, not a defect in the change: the dispatch context labels fd066c452bf634036eb112d277d6533f29ce0989 as the product commit (work_head_commit), while the committed implement handoff reports work_head_commit fc8ab749cb368a1d933f7dc991ff87eb6064eed4. This is consistent with fd066c45 being the materializer's metadata-only commit stacked on the actor's product commit fc8ab749, which the contract explicitly permits.
